title: Punishment for Israel's Sin

questions.question: Rejoice not, O Israel! Exult not like the peoples; for you have played the whore, forsaking your God. You have loved a prostitute's wages on all what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:1 (ESV): "You have loved a prostitute's wages on all threshing floors."

questions.question: They shall not remain in the land of the Lord, but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:3 (ESV): "but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean food in Assyria."

questions.question: The days of punishment have come; the days of recompense have come; Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool; the man of the spirit is what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:7 (ESV): "The prophet is a fool; the man of the spirit is mad,"

questions.question: Ephraim's glory shall fly away like a bird—no birth, no pregnancy, no what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:11 (ESV): "no birth, no pregnancy, no conception!"

questions.question: My God will reject them because they have not listened to him; they shall be wanderers among whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:17 (ESV): "they shall be wanderers among the nations."

questions.question: Threshing floor and wine vat shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail them.
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:2 (ESV): "Threshing floor and wine vat shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail them."

questions.question: They shall not pour drink offerings of wine to the Lord, and their sacrifices shall not please him. It shall be like what to them?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:4 (ESV): "It shall be like mourners' bread to them;"

questions.question: For behold, they are going away from destruction; but Egypt shall gather them; Memphis shall bury them. Nettles shall possess their precious things of what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:6 (ESV): "Nettles shall possess their precious things of silver;"

questions.question: The prophet is the watchman of Ephraim with my God; yet a fowler's snare is on all his ways, and hatred in the house of his what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:8 (ESV): "and hatred in the house of his God."

questions.question: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:9 (ESV): "They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah:"

questions.question: Like grapes in the wilderness, I found Israel. Like the first fruit on the fig tree in its first season, I saw your fathers. But they came to where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:10 (ESV): "But they came to Baal-peor and consecrated themselves to the thing of shame,"

questions.question: Give them, O Lord—what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:14 (ESV): "Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts."

questions.question: Every evil of theirs is in where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:15 (ESV): "Every evil of theirs is in Gilgal; there I began to hate them."

questions.question: Ephraim is stricken; their root is dried up; they shall bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, I will put their beloved children to what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:16 (ESV): "I will put their beloved children to death."

questions.question: What shall grow in their tents?
questions.explanation: Hosea 9:6 (ESV): "thorns shall be in their tents."

key_verse_text: The days of punishment have come; the days of recompense have come; Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool; the man of the spirit is mad, because of your great iniquity and great hatred.
